sections.heading: Pune: Home of the World's Largest Vaccine Maker
paragraphs: Pune's claim on hygienic stainless tube starts at Hadapsar, where the Serum Institute of India has been based since Dr Cyrus Poonawalla founded it in 1966. By the company's own account it is now the world's largest vaccine manufacturer by doses produced and sold, more than 1.5 billion a year, covering polio, diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, Hib, BCG, recombinant hepatitis B, measles, mumps, rubella, pneumococcal and Covid-19 vaccines. Its vaccines are WHO-accredited and used in the national immunisation programmes of around 170 countries.

The newer capacity is at Manjari, where the Poonawalla Biotech Park covers 42 acres and is designed to the standards of the MHRA, the US FDA and the regulators of Europe, Japan and Australia. Serum lists HPV, TdaP, rotavirus and recombinant BCG vaccines and monoclonal antibodies and biosimilars among the first products for the site. Serum also describes facilities for polysaccharide and recombinant vaccines, cell factories and cell cubes for growing cells, and robotic virus handling, each of which is served by validated water, media and buffer lines.

sections.heading: Hinjawadi's Pharma and Bioprocess Cluster
paragraphs: Across the city at Hinjawadi, Emcure Pharmaceuticals, founded in 1981 by Satish Mehta, has its headquarters and a cluster of plants: a solid-dosage facility that received US FDA approval in 2006 and makes oral formulations for regulated markets, a small-volume parenteral facility approved by the US FDA and the UK MHRA with pre-filled syringe capability, an oncology injectables facility and a biotech facility. Wikipedia notes that several of these sites have at times been under US FDA warning letters, which is a reminder of how closely the regulator looks at injectable plants.

Hinjawadi is also where Praj Industries has its head office. Praj began as a supplier of ethanol plants in the early 1980s and today engineers bioenergy, brewery, high-purity water and critical process equipment projects, with manufacturing in Pune, Kandla and Wada and more than 1,000 references in over 100 countries. Its subsidiary Praj HiPurity Systems builds purified water and water-for-injection generation, storage and distribution systems and CIP and SIP systems for the pharmaceutical, biotech and food sectors, and its brewery division claims over 70 percent of the Indian market. Pune, in other words, is a city where hygienic skids are designed and built, not only installed.

sections.heading: SF4 316L for Pune Vaccine and Injectable Lines, SF1 for Bioenergy Utilities
paragraphs: A vaccine or biologics plant is the most demanding user of electropolished tube in Pune. Using ASME BPE surface designations, SF4 316L, mechanically polished then electropolished, is the finish for WFI and purified water distribution, buffer and media preparation and transfer, bioreactor and harvest lines, formulation and filling support lines and CIP return. The electropolished bore has fewer surface defects for biofilm and endotoxin-bearing residue to anchor in, rinses faster, and its chromium-rich passive film resists rouging in hot WFI loops, which is why a validation team will ask for it on every product-contact line.

On the bioenergy and brewery side that Praj serves, SF4 316L is still the choice for fermentation feed, yeast propagation, wort and beer lines and CIP, but SF1 304L or 316L, mechanically polished only, is adequate for cooling water, utilities and transfer lines that are cleaned without being validated. For acidic or chloride-bearing process streams in API or biorefinery service, we quote 904L, which we supply electropolished. We supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube, and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L.

sections.heading: Paperwork for a Pune Validation File
paragraphs: A regulated plant in Pune keeps a turnover package for every hygienic system, and the tube records go into it. Each heat we supply has an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number and chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory. Every length is PMI tested before dispatch, so a 304L tube cannot be installed where the isometric calls for 316L, and each electropolished lot carries our internal Ra report for the surface-finish section of the file.

Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015. If the skid builder's or owner's specification requires additional testing, witness inspection or a defined marking scheme on each length, put it in the enquiry so the quotation already covers it.

sections.heading: Sending a Pune RFQ
paragraphs: We quote within 24 hours of a complete enquiry. For vaccine, biologics, injectable, bioenergy or brewery projects in and around Pune, tell us:
bullets: The plant and system: WFI or purified water loop, buffer and media lines, bioreactor and harvest piping, fill support, CIP, or a fermentation or brewhouse line, and whether you are the owner, an EPC contractor or a skid builder.
Grade and bore finish per line: SF4 316L for product contact, WFI and CIP, SF1 304L or 316L for utilities, 904L electropolished for aggressive process streams.
OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312.
Validation or inspection requirements from your quality team, and the delivery address, whether Hadapsar, Manjari, Hinjawadi or another Pune site.

sections.heading: Supplying Pune from Mumbai
paragraphs: Pune is a direct road run from our base at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004. Tube leaves with capped ends and the heat number marked on each length, and your quotation confirms the dispatch date and transit to site in writing.
